t: Napoleon's ally Frederick I proclaimed the kingdom in 1806 and roughly doubled the old duchy's territory.
The constitution of 1819, agreed with the estates, made Württemberg a leading constitutional state of southern Germany.
Within the German Empire it kept its own army corps, posts and railways until the king renounced the throne in 1918.
dyk: The Cannstatter Wasen, one of Germany's largest folk festivals, began in 1818 as an agricultural fair founded by King William I after the famine of 1816–1817.
ev: Elector Frederick proclaims himself King Frederick I of Württemberg
The Treaty of Fulda brings Württemberg over to the Allies
William I agrees a constitution with the estates
Württemberg joins the German Customs Union
Württemberg troops are defeated by Prussia at Tauberbischofsheim
Württemberg becomes a federal state of the German Empire
Robert Bosch opens his workshop in Stuttgart
King William II renounces the throne on 30 November
